Intermediate Architectural Designer, Architecture + Emerging Technology
Spacematter | New York City, NY | Full-Time
Experience: 4–8 Years
Salary: $75,000–$110,000 annually
About Spacematter
Spacematter is an AI-powered architecture and technology company rethinking how buildings are designed, documented, and delivered.
We are expanding our New York City architectural team and seeking an Intermediate Architectural Designer with strong design and technical capabilities, a solid foundation in traditional architectural practice, and a genuine interest in emerging technologies.
Our approach combines architectural expertise with AI, automation, and computational design to create more intelligent and efficient workflows.
The Role
We are looking for a talented architectural designer who understands how buildings are designed, detailed, coordinated, and documented.
This is a hands-on architectural role, not a software development position. You will work directly with an experienced architectural director on real projects while gaining exposure to emerging AI-powered design and production tools.
We are particularly interested in candidates who are comfortable with established architectural delivery methods but enthusiastic about exploring new ways of working.
Key Responsibilities
Qualifications
Why Join Spacematter?
At Spacematter, we believe technology should empower architects, not replace them.
Our team works on real architectural projects with real clients, maintaining the professional standards, design quality, and technical rigor expected of an established architecture practice.
You will work directly with one of Spacematter's architectural directors, receiving professional leadership, mentorship, and guidance from an experienced architect, not an AI system.
You will also have the opportunity to collaborate with our technology and product development teams, contributing to the evolution of AI-powered architectural tools and workflows.
We value architects and designers who understand the fundamentals of the profession but are curious about how technology can improve the way buildings are designed and delivered.
This is an opportunity to join a growing company at the intersection of architecture and technology, combining the experience of traditional architectural practice with the possibilities of emerging technologies.
Compensation
Annual Salary: $75,000–$110,000, commensurate with experience, technical capabilities, and qualifications.
How to Apply

We welcome candidates who are passionate about architecture, technically capable, and interested in helping shape the future of architectural practice.
